title: Xtra Weapons
description: This mod adds 10+ weapons, and they are all obtainable in survival minecraft!
body:
Have you ever been bored with the normal assortment of weapons and need something more to get? Well, look no further! 
This mod adds: 
- 10+ weapons soon to have thier own abilities! 
- They all have fun designs, and are sure to make you experience better! 
- All of these weapons are obtainable in survival minecraft, so you can add this to your survival world to make more of a grind! 
- PvP with this is very fun, because of the special abilities, PvP will be more exiting!
  ![Some (4) of the swords shown here](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6f115b64e121ecc6b274736571bb7c973b3396bd.png)
(It is reccomended to play in creative, but still possible in survival)
